monitored_text: Home Newsroom JLCCNC 2026 New Year’s Day Holiday Notice JLCCNC 2026 New Year’s Day Holiday Notice Press Release Dec 30, 2025 JLCCNC factories will have a 1-day holiday on January 1, 2026. During this time, orders can still be placed and customer service will remain available. Note: CNC machining and sheet metal Orders placed after 6 pm, December 31th GMT+8 will start to produce on January 2, 2026. The delivery date will be postponed accordingly. JLCCNC Holiday Schedule Logistics companies Schedule Customer Service Customer service will remain available throughout the holiday to assist with inquiries and order support.Thank you for your understanding and continued support.
